messages:
Asha: Thanks everyone for joining today's all-hands. Quick tidy-up: short list of clarified asks, owners, and next steps. Will keep it minimal. (Recording + slides below)
Jordan: Thanks — two quick clarifications: 1) Dedicated GA date? 2) Any change to the deprecation plan for v1 routing?
Asha: Good Qs. Dedicated GA target = 'end of Q2' (still dependent on infra perf tests). No change to v1 routing deprecation window yet — product will post formal timeline next week. Owner: @Asha to publish timeline by Tue 9am PT.
Kim: For infra perf tests, who owns the test harness and can we get early results? I can pair with infra.
Carlos: I can own the harness. Will iterate with @Kim. Action: Carlos + Kim to run perf sweep on p3/rtx by next Fri. (I'll create a tracking ticket)
Priya: Can we get a short summary of the tradeoffs on quantization suggestions you mentioned? We need that for Customer Ops.
Asha: Yep — short doc with suggested quant profiles + expected p50/p95 latency impact. Owner: @Priya to collect customer asks; @Asha will draft the recommendation doc by Thu EOD.
Matt: Quick note — prioritize stability for the enterprise pilot customers. If we need to delay a GA feature to keep SLAs solid, do it. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Recording uploaded: https://redwood.cloud/ah/rec/2901234567
deploy-bot: Slides uploaded: https://redwood.cloud/ah/slides/2901234567
Jordan: Thanks — adding to my exec summary.
Asha: Owners summary:
- Dedicated GA timeline doc: Asha (due Tue 09:00 PT)
- Perf harness + sweep: Carlos & Kim (due Fri)
- Quantization tradeoffs doc: Asha + Priya (due Thu EOD)
- Enterprise pilot stability runbook: Matt + EngSRE (Matt to follow up)
Carlos: I'll create the GitHub issue and link it here: https://github.com/redwood/inference/issues/842
Priya: Can someone ping legal about data residency questions for Private? CC @Matt
Asha: Will ping legal and add to the doc. FYI I'll do a 15-min sync tomorrow 11am PT for anyone who wants to jump in — note: calendar invite sent.
Jordan: :thumbsup:
Kim: i'll be there. quick ask — can we get the test config snippet in the issue? e.g., 
```
batch_size: 16
sequence_len: 1024
quant: int8
```

Carlos: added the config and labels in the issue.
Asha: Thanks all. If there are other calls to action you want me to add, reply here and I'll append. Otherwise I'll update the thread after the sync with owners + links.
